name: ChurnSaveDeskWorkbench
tagline: Save more customers – with offers that protect your margin.
description: A complete telecom retention save-desk app for Power Apps and Power Pages: cancellation requests prioritised by CLV and churn risk, eligible save offers checked against margin guardrails with supervisor approval, first-contact and callback queues, a save pipeline and save-rate KPIs. Works instantly with demo data and connects to any table in a few clicks.
features: Save priority from CLV × churn risk
Calculated or mapped CLV and risk score
Offer catalogue with margin, CLV-share and approval guardrails
Kanban pipeline with transition rules, drag & drop and keyboard moves
Save rate by reason and agent, offer acceptance, revenue saved
Bulk assign, callbacks and status changes with undo
controlType: standard (2 controls: ChurnSaveDeskWorkbench data-set + ChurnSaveDeskWorkbenchPortal field control, shared src/app)
